notes: W0 gate sheet. 5 abilities x 6 requests, voseo, low computer literacy phrasing. key_terms are the words that must survive speech recognition for the request to be understood; they are checked after normalisation (accents stripped, digits turned into words). A human verdict overrides the automatic one.
